run_word_alignment: run supervised word alignment between source and target embeddings using RCSLS with a bilingual dictionary
run_alignment_with_sgd: run word alignment optimization using SGD with configurable batch size and learning rate
run_alignment_with_spectral: run word alignment with spectral projection constraints on the transformation matrix
run_alignment_with_centering: run word alignment with centered embeddings using the center flag for better alignment quality
run_alignment_save_output: run word alignment and save aligned embeddings and transformation matrix to output files
